payload.explanation: Replace the exclusive surface and dynamic-binding lifecycle with a normal menu plugin, statically loaded compositor bindings, an armed universal release handler, restricted mapping-file permissions, atomic saves, and standard-input delivery to the typing helper.

steps: Load a reviewed static Menu submap from the user's compositor binding configuration rather than adding and removing live binding handles.
Use a normal menu window for editing and a universal release handler that opens the editor only when no letter action has disarmed it.
Restrict the plaintext mapping file to its owner, save it atomically, validate the selected letter, and stream mapped text to the typing helper over standard input.
Reload the compositor, inspect configuration errors, summon and dismiss the editor, and complete physical Menu-key and mapped-text tests before calling the behavior fully verified.

payload.effects: A Menu-key tap can open an editor and Menu plus a letter can type stored plaintext. The plugin adds a compositor submap and reads sensitive-by-choice local text, so it is not suitable as a credential vault.
payload.rollback: Remove the marked static loader from the user bindings, reload the compositor, disable the plugin, and remove its optional mapping file only with separate approval.
payload.validation_plan: Run model, wrapper, editor, manifest, Lua syntax, runtime-stub, and plugin validation checks. Confirm a clean compositor reload and normal editor summon/dismiss, then physically test one tap, one mapped letter, Escape, and an unmatched key.

activation.details: Load the static binding file through the user compositor configuration and reload the compositor.
